equivalency_validation_summary.error_details: All 15 statement pairs returned ERROR with 'uniqueID' error from the SQL Equivalency tool. This appears to be a service-level issue affecting all validations regardless of statement complexity. Per transformation definition, all statuses come exclusively from the tool output - no agent judgment was used.
equivalency_validation_summary.note: The 'uniqueID' error was consistent across simple (SELECT, DELETE) and complex (CTE with window functions) statements, confirming a service-level issue rather than statement-specific problems.
